curated.lethality_detail_zh: 肾灌注骤降（休克/脓毒症）、肾毒性药物或尿路梗阻在48小时至7天内导致肾功能急剧恶化、水钠潴留与尿毒症毒素蓄积；重度AKI可于数小时至数日内因高钾血症心搏骤停、难治性肺水肿及多器官功能障碍（MODS）死亡，ICU需要透析患者的住院病死率常达50%以上。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 无特异性“逆转肾小管坏死”药物，以迅速去除病因（纠休克、停肾毒药、解梗阻）、精准容量管理及CRRT器官替代为基石；轻中度且肾前性/梗阻性AKI及时处理可完全复原，但重症伴MODS者病死率极高且相当比例幸存者遗留慢性肾脏病（AKI-to-CKD转化）。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO/GBD死因清单未将AKI单独列为单一根本死因（多归于脓毒症、心源性休克或中毒原发病）；KDIGO估算全球每年数百万例住院患者并发AKI并相关死亡，普通住院AKI总体病死率约20%，ICU需肾脏替代治疗者达50%以上

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 无国家单列死因总数；杨莉团队《柳叶刀》中国全国调查显示综合住院患者AKI高漏诊（仅约1/4被及时诊断）、总体院内病死率约12%-13%，国内ICU危重病人AKI发生率超30%且病死率显著升高

epidemiology.prevalence_global: KDIGO统计全球住院患者AKI发生率约为10%-15%，在重症监护室（ICU）中发生率高达30%-50%以上。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 北京大学第一医院等牵头全国多中心调查估算中国每年住院患者中约有数百万人次发生AKI（《柳叶刀》研究推算约140万-290万例住院患者发生AKI，总漏诊率高达74%以上），药源性与脓毒症占主要病因。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: KDIGO急性期救治规范：1) 立即停用全部非必需肾毒性药物（氨基糖苷类、NSAIDs、含碘对比剂等）及排查超声泌尿系梗阻；2) 有创/动态容量评估下迅速恢复有效肾灌注压（晶体液复苏+必要时去甲肾上腺素升压）；3) 高钾血症即刻钙剂护心+降钾；4) 出现利尿剂抵抗性急性肺水肿、重度高钾、严重酸中毒（pH<7.15）或尿毒症脑病/心包炎时立即开通连续性肾脏替代治疗（CRRT）。

clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 住院全程按日常基本医疗支出减负及DRG结算；如需行ICU连续性肾脏替代治疗（CRRT），治疗操作费约200-350元/次，另需加收一次性体外管路、滤器及置换液耗材，总体费用随休克脓毒症救治周期显著升高

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 早筛生物标志物（如TIMP-2×IGFBP7 [NephroCheck]、NGAL及电子病历AKI实时预警系统）在全球ICU推广，可提前12-24小时识别亚临床肾小管损伤；2) STARRT-AKI及AKIKI-2等大型多中心RCT明确在无危及生命合并症时不提倡过早盲目启动CRRT；3) 靶向线粒体保护、抗凋亡及间充质干细胞修复AKI制剂（如Reldesemtiv/Teprasiran等曾探索路径）持续探索肾小管再生靶点。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 目前全球尚无任何一种获批临床应用的特异性促进肾小管上皮再生/逆转已发生AKI的靶向药物；2) 中国住院患者AKI漏诊率超过七成、非肾科药物性AKI（中药、抗生素、止痛药联用）监测乏力；3) 缺乏有效阻止AKI向CKD纤维化慢性转化的临床干预方案。

master.definition_en: A non-seminomatous malignant germ cell tumor arising from the testis. It affects infants, young children, and postpubertal males. curated.category: 罕见单基因骨骼发育障碍
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 常染色体显性FGFR3基因热点突变（约97%为c.1138G>A）导致软骨内成骨受抑，是最常见的非致死性不成比例矮小症；绝大多数患者寿命接近正常，但婴儿期必须高度警惕“枕骨大孔狭窄压迫脑干”导致的呼吸暂停与婴儿猝死风险（未筛查监测者婴儿期猝死风险显著升高）。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 已告别仅靠高风险断骨增高手术的时代：全球首个针对FGFR3病因的C型利钠肽类似物伏索利肽（Vosoritide / 维克卓）已在中国获批上市，每日皮下注射可持续改善儿童生长速度与肢体比例；配合婴儿期颅颈交界区监测可有效保障安全。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: Orphanet未单列全球年死亡人数，婴儿期枕骨大孔狭窄致脑干压迫是主要可预防猝死原因

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球活产发病率约1/15,000–1/25,000（Orphanet ORPHA:15），约80%为父母身高正常的新发突变（与父亲高龄相关）
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国临床估算活产发病率与全球相近，每年新增患儿约数百例，已纳入国家第一批罕见病目录

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 婴儿期枕骨大孔压迫猝死警报：1) 1岁以内婴儿若出现频繁呼吸暂停、喂养发绀、打鼾憋气或四肢突然无力，立即送三甲儿科急查头颅及颈椎MRI排查枕骨大孔狭窄压迫脑干；2) 确诊重度压迫者需神经外科及时行枕下减压术，切勿拖延。

standard_drugs.drug_class: 重组C型利钠肽（CNP）类似物（直接拮抗过度激活的FGFR3下游MAPK信号，恢复软骨内成骨）
standard_drugs.usage_role: 骨骺尚未闭合的软骨发育不全儿童每日1次皮下注射病因靶向治疗（中国NMPA已获批）
standard_drugs.cost_estimate_cny: 国内新近获批自费特药，参考海外及国内特许定价年治疗费用约合人民币100万–180万元
standard_drugs.cost_source: NMPA批准及公开商业定价报道

non_drug_therapies_zh: 家系遗传排查：约80%患儿父母身高正常（新发突变，同胞再发风险<1%）；但患者本人成年后生育，子代有50%遗传风险（若父母双方均为ACH患者，子代有25%纯合致死型风险），育龄患者强烈建议行PGT-M或产前基因诊断
婴儿期安全护理：2岁前使用硬质靠背婴儿车与后向安全座椅，严禁过早竖抱或使用软兜背带以防颈椎过度前屈加重脊髓压迫及胸腰椎后凸
定期监测头围、多导睡眠呼吸监测（排查阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停）、中耳炎积液（防传导性耳聋）及下肢O型腿畸形
clinical_management.annual_total_cost_china_cny: 常规多学科随访、睡眠及骨科支具管理年费约3,000–10,000元；若使用伏索利肽靶向治疗，年药品费用约100万元人民币以上

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 伏索利肽（Vosoritide）已在中国获批，中国真实世界COREV研究证实其可持续提升儿童年化生长速率并改善身体比例；2) 口服高选择性FGFR3酪氨酸激酶抑制剂Infigratinib在3期PROPEL-3临床试验中正评估每日口服替代注射的疗效；3) 每周1次长效CNP前药TransCon CNP（Navepegritide）在3期ApproaCH试验中展现优异的生长与安全性数据。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 伏索利肽目前尚未纳入国家常规药品目录，百万级年费令绝大多数普通家庭望而却步；2) 每日皮下注射对幼儿依从性挑战大，亟待口服Infigratinib或长效周制剂获批；3) 成人期椎管狭窄腰痛与社会无障碍环境支持仍有待改善。

master.definition_en: Spinocerebellar ataxia type 1 (SCA1) is a subtype of type I autosomal dominant cerebellar ataxia (ADCA type I) characterized by dysarthria, writing difficulties, limb ataxia, and commonly nystagmus and saccadic abnormalities.

curated.name_zh: 脊髓小脑性共济失调1型
curated.category: 罕见遗传性神经退行性疾病
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 常染色体显性ATXN1基因CAG三核苷酸异常扩增所致（整体SCA家族还包括中国最常见的SCA3/马查多-约瑟夫病等）；以进行性步态醉酒样摇晃、构音含糊、眼球运动障碍和吞咽呛咳为核心，通常起病后10–20年因延髓麻痹致吸入性肺炎或呼吸衰竭危及生命。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 目前尚无获批的逆转或阻止小脑浦肯野细胞退变的特效药；临床主要通过康复平衡训练、防跌倒改造、吞咽护理及部分对症药物改善共济失调、肌张力障碍或震颤，全球多款靶向降低突变ATXN1/SCA致病蛋白的反义寡核苷酸（ASO）与谷氨酸调节剂正处于临床试验阶段。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球SCA1患病率约1–9/10万（整体常染色体显性小脑共济失调约1/33,000–1/50,000，Orphanet ORPHA:98755）

non_drug_therapies_zh: 家系遗传排查与生育阻断：常染色体显性遗传（子代男女各有50%遗传风险，且存在“遗传早现”现象即子代发病更早更重）；先证者确诊后，成年高危亲属可在充分遗传咨询后行CAG动态突变检测，育龄患者强烈建议通过PGT-M（第三代试管婴儿）或产前诊断彻底阻断家族传递
居家防跌倒改造（防滑地垫、浴室扶手、助行器）及核心平衡/步态物理康复

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 1) 谷氨酸调节剂Troriluzole（利鲁唑前药）开展了覆盖SCA1/2/3/6/7/10的3期临床试验并推进真实世界长期延缓进展数据提交监管审评；2) 靶向降低突变ATXN1（以及SCA3的ATXN3）mRNA的反义寡核苷酸（ASO，如Vico Therapeutics的VO659等）与AAV-miRNA基因沉默疗法正在1/2期临床推进中。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 尚无获批的疾病修饰药物能够阻止小脑及脑干神经元进行性萎缩；2) 常规外显子测序无法检出CAG动态重复扩增，必须做专门的动态突变毛细管电泳检测；3) 家族性患者常因心理病耻感隐瞒家族史，错失PGT-M阻断机会。

master.definition_en: Hyperprolinaemia type I is an inborn error of proline metabolism characterized by elevated levels of proline in the plasma and urine. The prevalence is unknown. The disorder is generally considered to be benign but associations with renal abnormalities, epileptic seizures, and other neurological manifestations, as well as certain forms of schizophrenia have been reported. It is transmitted as an autosomal recessive trait and is caused by mutations in the proline dehydrogenase or proline oxidase gene (PRODH or POX, 22q11.2).

mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

master.definition_en: Isovaleric acidemia (IVA) is an autosomal recessively inherited organic aciduria characterized by a deficiency in isovaleryl-CoA dehydrogenase, that has wide clinical variability and that can present in infancy with acute manifestations of vomiting, failure to thrive, seizures, lethargy, a characteristic ''sweaty feet'' odor, acute pancreatitis and mild to severe developmental delay or in childhood with metabolic acidosis (brought on by prolonged fasting, an increased intake of protein-rich food or infections) and that can be fatal if not treated immediately. Chronic intermittent presentations and asymptomatic patients have also been reported.

master.definition_en: PHACE is an acronym used to describe a syndrome characterized by the association of posterior fossa brain malformations, large facial haemangiomas, anatomical anomalies of the cerebral arteries, aortic coarctation and other cardiac anomalies, and eye abnormalities. Sternal anomalies are also sometimes present, and in these cases the syndrome is referred to as PHACES. Two additional manifestations have recently been added to the clinical spectrum of PHACE syndrome: stenosis of the vessels at the base of the skull and segmental longitudinal dilations of the internal carotid artery.

master.definition_en: Glycine N-methyltransferase deficiency (GNMT deficiency) is a very rare condition characterized by persistent and isolated excess levels of methionine in the blood (hypermethioninemia). The only clinical abnormalities are mild increase of the liver size (hepatomegaly) and chronic elevation of the transaminase levels in the blood without liver disease. Methionine may also be increased in urine. However, because elevated levels of methionine in the blood itself is a risk factor for development of neurological signs and symptoms, people with GNMT deficiency can have neurological problems when methionine levelsare greater than 800μmol/L. GNMT deficiency is caused by mutations in the GNMT gene. Inheritance is autosomal recessive. Treatment is not needed in most cases.
synonyms_en: hypermethioninemia due to glycine N-methyltransferase deficiency
mondo_categories: disease of genetic or genomic mechanism

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 以遗传性易栓症、急性肺栓塞、主动脉夹层、恶性心律失常和脑出血为代表的急症，平时毫无征兆，往往在睡梦中或静息状态下几分钟内危及生命——家人根本来不及反应。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 需要发展连续无创可穿戴微循环/血氧/心电多模态传感器、血液微凝血活性快速试纸，结合 AI 在异常触发前几小时识别微血栓与高危信号并立即叫醒预警。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 急诊极危重期的快速再通与器官细胞保护
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把“几分钟决定生死”的抢救窗口拓宽成“几小时可救回”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 对急性心梗、脑梗死、脓毒性休克、急性肝衰竭与热射病而言，哪怕送到急诊室，微血管再灌注损伤、细胞因子风暴和不可逆线粒体坏死仍会在短时间内夺走生命。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 研发免复杂配型的超快精准溶栓与导管微取栓器械、阻断微血栓级联炎症风暴药物，以及在缺血缺氧期守住心肌与脑神经元存活的细胞保护剂。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 急性多器官微循环级联动力学建模、急诊快速炎症/凝血表型分型、老药新用紧急器官保护筛选。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复

breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。
breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 推进高精度体内 CRISPR 碱基/先导编辑、低免疫原性肝/神经靶向病毒载体（AAV）与脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送，以及患者自体干细胞精准修复移植，让身体自己恢复生产正常蛋白。
breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: AI 指导低脱靶编辑器设计、肝脏/心肌/神经组织特异启动子预测、蛋白功能残基致病性建模。

breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 跨生理屏障递送与 RNA / 蛋白稳态重塑
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 把药真正送进大脑、心脏与深层致密病灶

breakthrough_tracks.direction_zh: 突破跨血脑屏障转运体载体、GalNAc-siRNA / ASO 精密肝脏与中枢基因沉默调控、靶向蛋白降解嵌合体（PROTAC）及虚拟细胞药效预测技术。

master.definition_en: Any autosomal dominant macrothrombocytopenia in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the TUBB1 gene, characterized by mild to moderate thrombocytopenia with large platelets and normal or near-normal bleeding symptoms. Structural studies in patient platelets show disorganized or reduced beta1-tubulin staining and abnormal marginal microtubule bands, impairing proplatelet formation and leading to fewer, larger circulating platelets. Functional platelet assays in affected individuals typically show qualitatively normal aggregation, with the clinical phenotype driven primarily by reduced platelet number rather than intrinsic platelet-function defects.
synonyms_en: autosomal dominant macrothrombocytopenia caused by mutation in TUBB1
